summary: Correct, minimal fix that generalizes the distributive-reduction path so Mod applied to individual Mul factors (e.g. Mod(3*i,2) -> Mod(i,2)) triggers restructuring even without a pre-existing inner Mod. Approach is sound, matches upstream intent, no clear regression.

issues.description: Dropped the explanatory '# finding distributive term' comment; the new `was`/`changed` logic would benefit from a one-line note on why non_mod_l is always recomputed and compared.

non_mod_l = [cls(x, q) ...] is now computed unconditionally (previously only when inner Mods present), adding a small recursive-eval cost on the common path, though the result is reused so impact is negligible.
